description: Reserve a time slot on an active configured calendar. Returns a pending_offer reservation and tries to send a 6-digit confirmation code to the customer's email or phone. The reservation expires in 15 minutes if not confirmed. Idempotent: re-using the same idempotency_key returns the original reservation and sends no code. If a send could not be confirmed, confirmation.delivered is false and not_sent_reason says whether a code may still arrive. At a business that takes a deposit for agent bookings, pass the offer_id from get_quote (without it the answer is quote_required); no code is sent and the result's payment block carries the amount to pay instead.

customer_contact.description: How to reach the customer. MUST include at least one of email or phone — the confirmation code is delivered there, and a hold nobody can confirm is unreachable from both sides. Email is used when both are present.

email.description: Where the 6-digit confirmation code is sent, preferred over phone

phone.description: SMS fallback for the confirmation code when no email is given. Any common way of writing a number is accepted and reformatted for you: (512) 317-1992, 512-317-1992 and 5123171992 all work, and a bare national number is read as US. Only input that cannot be read as a number at all is refused, and then only when no email was supplied, since a hold nobody can confirm is worse than a refused call.

offer_id.description: Optional id of a signed get_quote offer to redeem against this reservation. Omit for a business with no exact-priced service — authentication is a capability upgrade here, never a toll.

window_end.description: Slot end (Unix seconds, an absolute instant) — the matching get_availability slot's `end`; see window_start.

window_start.description: Slot start (Unix seconds, an absolute instant). Take it from a get_availability slot: that response carries the business's `timezone`, so request a wide availability window there and filter the returned slots locally rather than guessing the zone.

name: reserve_slot

booking_authorization.description: Present this summary and booking_details to the customer and obtain explicit agreement before passing its reference to confirm_booking.

booking_details.description: For configured calendars: present these fixed booking details to the customer before confirming their code. No owner approval is required.

channel.description: The channel this call chose for the code: 'email' or 'sms'. It does not say a send was attempted or confirmed; delivered and not_sent_reason say that. 'none' when it chose none: on an idempotent replay, with method 'payment', or when the email send budget refused and the contact left no usable phone

delivered.description: With method 'otp', false means nothing confirmed that a code went on this call, and the booking cannot be confirmed until one reaches the customer. On an idempotent replay it is always false, because a replay sends nothing: the first call's answer stands. With method 'payment' it is always false, because no code is sent

method.description: 'otp': this booking is confirmed with a 6-digit code; delivered and not_sent_reason say whether one went on this call. 'payment': no code — this booking is confirmed by paying the deposit in `payment`

not_sent_reason.description: With method 'otp', present when this call could not confirm that a code went; absent on an idempotent replay, which sends nothing. 'daily_limit': a daily messaging limit was reached, so no code went. 'not_sent': no code was sent and none will arrive, because nothing could send it to this contact. 'unavailable': a send was attempted and its outcome is unknown, so a code may still arrive. Tell the customer which it is, and offer the business's other contact

retry_after.description: ISO-8601 UTC, with daily_limit only. Daily send budgets reset at this time. A new reservation may retry then, subject to current budgets and delivery availability

expires_at.description: ISO-8601. When this hold lapses if it is not confirmed (by code, or by payment when payment.required)

idempotent_replay.description: Present and true when this idempotency_key already had a reservation; no new code was sent

payment.description: Always present. required:false — confirm with the code (confirmation.method 'otp'). required:true — the customer pays amount_cents (currency) to confirm; balance_due_cents is paid at the visit.

status.description: Reservation state — 'pending_offer' on a fresh hold; a replay returns the existing row's state

title: Reserve Time Slot
